title: WEBTOON Launches 1st Global Drop With The Warrior's Ballad
content:
WEBTOON Entertainment has launched its first "Global Drop" project with The Warrior's Ballad , releasing the fantasy webtoon simultaneously in nine languages on September 19.

Global Drop is a new initiative that releases highly anticipated new and returning webtoons in multiple languages without a time delay between regions. This marks the first time WEBTOON Entertainment has simultaneously launched an ongoing series across nine language services.

Written by Dodongpa, adapted by Namwoon, and drawn by Street Bard, The Warrior's Ballad is based on Dodongpa's web novel of the same name. It follows a powerful sword master who is reincarnated 100 years after his death as a boy named Ricardt.

The series launched in Korean, Japanese, English, French, German, Spanish, Thai, Indonesian, and Traditional Chinese.

Fans can read the English version on WEBTOON .

title: 'Kakunaru Ue wa' Reveals Additional Staff, First Promo for Winter 2027
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kyuu Takahata and Yuuji Kaba 's Kakunaru Ue wa ( Now That We Draw ) manga revealed additional staff, a character visual (pictured above), and the first promotional video on Thursday. The anime series will premiere in January 2027.

Staff Sub-character Design: Momoka Izumi ( Yofukashi no Uta animation director) Color Design: Yurie Matsuura ( Koi wa Futago de Warikirenai ) Art Director: Arei Saiga ( Kabushikigaisha Magi-Lumière background art) Director of Photography: Hayato Kifune (EOTA) ( Nippon Sangoku ) 3DCG: Masashi Watanabe ( Akebi-chan no Sailor-fuku ) Editing: Mai Hasegawa (editz) ( Blue Lock ) Sound Director: Fumiyuki Gou ( Tomodachi no Imouto ga Ore ni dake Uzai ) Sound Effects: Ryuuta Nakahara ( Jingai Kyoushitsu no Ningengirai Kyoushi ) Music: Yoshiaki Miura

Shunsuke Ishikawa ( Blue Lock: Episode Nagi ) is directing the anime at ROLL2 , with Deko Akao ( Witch Watch ) handling the series composition and script. Hiromi Nakagawa ( Shiro Seijo to Kuro Bokushi ) is designing the characters.

Takahata and Kaba began serializing the romantic comedy manga in Young Animal in February 2023. Hakusensha published the seventh volume on April 28, with the eighth volume went on sale on September 29.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga for English release in September 2024 and published the fifth volume on July 28, with the sixth volume is planned for a December 22 release.

title: Snowball Earth Manga Heads to Final Arc, Exceeds 1 Million Copies in Circulation
content:
Manga author Yuhiro Tsujitsugu announced on their X (formerly Twitter ) account on Thursday that their Snowball Earth manga has exceeded 1 million copies in circulation. Additionally, Tsujitsugu announced that the manga is starting its final arc. Tsujitsugu drew an illustration to celebrate the manga's 1 million milestone.

In the year 2025, huge beasts from beyond the galaxy attacked Earth. In the war that followed, humanity fought back with a giant robot named Yukio, piloted by Tetsuo Yabusame. As the massive alien swarm closed in on humanity's homeworld, Tetsuo and the Earth Defense Force deployed for the final battle with the invading horde. They lost… Yukio was destroyed in battle and Tetsuo survived in an escape pod. After eight years in cold sleep, the escape pod finally lands back on Earth. But when Tetsuo emerges he finds a world in ruins, entirely frozen beneath a blanket of ice and snow— Snowball Earth ! What happened to humanity, how did the planet freeze over, and will Tetsuo be able to keep his last promise to Yukio?

Tsujitsugu launched the manga in Shogakukan 's Monthly Spirits magazine in 2021. Shogakukan will publish the manga's 12th compiled book volume on September 30. Viz Media will publish the manga's 10th volume in English on December 15.

The manga's anime adaptation premiered on NTV 's extended Friday night programming block on April 3. Hulu streamed the anime as it aired. The anime is getting a second season.

title: 'Now That We Draw' Anime's 1st Full Promo Video Unveils More Staff, January 2027 Debut
content:
The official website for the television anime of Kyū Takahata and Yūji Kaba 's Now That We Draw ( Kakunaru Ue wa ) manga presented the anime's first full promotional video and character visuals on Thursday. The video announces additional staff members and the January 2027 premiere for the anime.

The newly announced staff members are:

• Sub-Character Design: Momoka Izumi

• Color Key Artist: Yurie Matsuura

• Art Director: Arei Saiga

• Compositing Director of Photography: Hayato Kifune (EOTA)

• 3D CG: Masashi Watanabe

• Editing: Mai Hasegawa

• Sound Director: Fumiyuki Go

• Sound Effects: Ryūta Nakahara

• Music: Yoshiaki Miura

• Produce: Infinite

Ayumu Murase and Sayumi Suzushiro will star as Yūki Uehara and Niina Miyamoto, respectively:

Dweeby high schooler Yūki Uehara has created the perfect romantic comedy heroine—she's bashful, airheaded, and completely chaste. When an editor at Uehara's dream publisher coldly dismisses his manga story as trite and lacking realism, it sends Uehara into a spiral of despair that pushes him into the path of his bubbly, gorgeous classmate, Niina Miyamoto—an aspiring manga artist herself! Having gotten similar feedback on her own manga, Miyamoto proposes she and Uehara engage in a fake relationship, since neither of them have any romantic experience. But Miyamoto is far from the perfect heroine Uehara's concocted, and he certainly isn't the cocky hero from her story either. Can their wacky relationship turn their manga dreams into reality, or will it lead to even more comic disasters?

Shunsuke Ishikawa ( BLUE LOCK THE MOVIE -EPISODE NAGI- ) is directing the anime at ROLL2 , and Deko Akao ( Arakawa Under the Bridge , Komi Can't Communicate ) is supervising and writing the series scripts. Hiromi Nakagawa ( WATATEN!: an Angel Flew Down to Me , Saint Cecilia and Pastor Lawrence ) is designing the characters, and Infinite is producing,

The manga launched in Hakusensha 's Young Animal magazine in 2023, and Hakusensha will publish the eighth volume on September 29. Seven Seas Entertainment published the fourth volume in English in February.

title: Bless Anime Reveals 2 More Cast Members
content:
The official website for the television anime of Yukino Sonoyama 's Bless manga revealed two more cast members in a character promotional video, on Thursday. Yoshino Aoyama will voice Oroka Sumeragi, and Momoka Terasawa will voice Shitataka Sumeragi.

The anime will star:

• Tomohiro Ōno as Aia Udagawa

• Chiyuki Miura as Jun Sumisaki

• Nobuhiko Okamoto as Ginga Yoyogi

Shōtarō Kitamura ( Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! ) is directing the anime at A-1 Pictures , and Takayuki Kikuchi (episode director for Solo Leveling , Kaguya-sama: Love is War ) is the assistant director. Fukurou Kamiza ( Non Non Biyori Nonstop ) is writing and overseeing the series scripts. Honoka Yokoyama ( Oshi no Ko TV 2 , Saint Cecilia and Pastor Lawrence ) is both the character designer and chief animation director, and Tetsuya Kawakami ( A Certain Magical Index , Sword Art Online ) and Reina Iwasaki ( VTuber Legend: How I Went Viral after Forgetting to Turn Off My Stream ) are also chief animation directors. Ryō Yoshimata ( Somali and the Forest Spirit , After the Rain ) is composing the music.

Other staff members include:

• Costume Design: Akane Takeda (A-1 Pictures)

• Prop Design: Takayuki Kidou

• Main Animators: Yūichirō Iida, Marina Kobayashi, Mirai Harashima (A-1 Pictures)

• Hair and Makeup Supervisor: Katsuyoshi Kojima (tron)

• Graphic Illustration: Kashimaki

• Color Design: Mana Hokuto (A-1 Pictures)

• Art Director: Risa Wakabayashi (A-1 Pictures)

• Background Art: Kiya Hirayoshi (A-1 Pictures)

• CG Director: Yuki Kuribayashi

• Director of Photography: Hideki Eto (EXPLOSION)

• Editing: Kiyoshi Hirose

• Sound Director: Kōhei Yoshida

• Sound Effects: Takuya Hasegawa

Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the manga in English and it describes the story:

They said Aia was destined to be a model, and Jun was bullied for her freckles. Together, they will take back the power to define themselves in an inspirational fashion manga that asks cutting questions about what it really means to be beautiful—and what it takes to overcome an arbitrary system that seems to respect talent over hard work.

Sonoyama debuted the manga in Kodansha 's Shonen Magazine Edge magazine in 2022, and the series now runs in Monthly Shonen Sirius . Kodansha will publish the ninth volume on October 8. The manga has more than 1.25 million copies in circulation.

Kodansha USA Publishing released the manga's seventh volume on February 10. Kodansha is also releasing the manga digitally on its K MANGA service.

The manga is also inspiring a live-action series that Amazon Prime Video will stream worldwide exclusively in spring 2027.
author: ANN

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Eight and Final Opening Featuring "LISTEN TO THE STEREO!!" by Going Under Ground
content:
Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its eight and final opening, featuring the song “LISTEN TO THE STEREO!!” by Going Under Ground. The song was used in Episodes 178-203, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.

The release follows yesterday’s release of the fourteenth ending, featuring the song “gr8 story” by SuG . The releases are part of “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” a September-long music project celebrating the anime’s 20th anniversary. As previously reported, the campaign will have creditless versions of the series’ past theme song sequences released daily on the official YouTube channel.

These creditless sequences were previously included with physical releases of the anime but had not been officially made available online. You can watch the latest entry below.

The campaign began on September 1 with an official 25-song playlist featuring opening themes, ending themes and other music from the TV anime.

The manga by Akira Amano ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from May 2004 to November 2012, ending with a total of 42 compilation volumes. The series also received an anime adaptation, which ran for 203 episodes from October 7, 2006 to September 25, 2010. Studio Artland handled the production. The anime is available on Crunchyroll , who describe the story: Tsuna, a timid junior high student, is a failure at school, sports, and social life. But everything around Tsuna has been completely changed when a baby called Reborn, who claims to be an Italian hit man from Vongola family shows up! Reborn was sent to groom Tsuna for his future life as a mafia boss of the family!

title: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World 2nd Season Anime Casts Shiki Aoki, Kazuyuki Okitsu
content:
The website for the second season of the television anime based on Nana Mikoshiba 's The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World ( Hyōken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu - Sekai Saikyō no Majutsushi de Aru Shōnen wa, Majutsu Gakuin ga Nyūgaku Suru ) light novel series revealed two additional cast members on Thursday.

Shiki Aoki will voice Rebecca's younger sister Maria Bradley (left in image above), and Kazuyuki Okitsu will voice Marius Basset, one of the Seven Great Magicians.

The anime will debut on TBS on October 8 at 1:23 a.m. and will then air on BS11 on October 9 at 11:00 p.m. Crunchyroll will stream the anime as it airs.

The returning cast includes:

• Junya Enoki as Ray White

• Iori Saeki as Amelia Ros

• Akira Sekine as Ariane Olgren

• Azumi Waki as Rebecca Bradley

• Kaede Hondo as Clarisse Cleveland

• Yūichirō Umehara as Evi Armstrong

• Kōhei Amasaki as Albert Allium

• Atsumi Tanezaki as Stella White

• Sōichirō Hoshi as Lucas Forst

• Haruka Shiraishi as Lizelotte Eden

Previously announced new cast members are:

• Hana Hishikawa as Olivia Arnold

• Ryōhei Kimura as Julius Orphe

• Aoi Koga as Bianca Miller

• Konomi Kohara as Emma Clarke

Miyu Kubota will voice Elisa Griffith. Kubota is replacing Nana Harumura , who retired from voice acting in January due to health reasons.

Masahiro Takata is returning to direct the anime, and is also returning to write and oversee the series scripts, and serve as sound director. Zero-G is now animating the series ( Cloud Hearts animated the first season). Other scriptwriters include Tomoko Shinozuka (returning from the first season) and Takahito Ōnishi ( Whisper Me a Love Song , My Happy Marriage ). Mariko Kawamoto ( Magica Wars ) is the new character designer, replacing Makoto Shimojima .

Sizuk will perform the opening theme song "Diamond Dust," and Maaya Uchida will perform the ending theme song "Compression :[."

Other staff members include:

• Art Director, Backgrounds: david production

• Art Setting: Junichirō Nishikawa

• Color Design: Fuyuto Muraguchi

• 3D: Cre-p Co., Ltd.

• Director of Photography: Tomomi Saitō

• Editing: Masaki Utsunomiya

• Sound Production: Bit Grooove Promotion

• Music: Tatsuhiko Saiki, Natsumi Tabuchi

• Music Production: Nichion

• Animation Producer: Takuji Obayashi

• Production Desk: Shōji Yamada

The first season of the television anime premiered in January 2023. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan, and also streamed an English dub .

Mikoshiba's original story launched on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō (Let's Become Novelists) website in October 2019. The light novel series debuted in July 2020, with illustrations by Riko Korie . Kodansha publishes the light novels in print in Japan.

Norihito Sasaki 's manga adaptation launched on Magazine Pocket in June 2020, and ended in January 2024. The manga's 16th and final volume shipped in April 2024.

The Arnold Academy of Magic is a school for the elite...and Ray White is just your ordinary guy. In fact, he doesn't seem particularly skilled with magic at all, and is a bit of a klutz. Which is why he has nothing to do with the rumor that one of the great magicians, the Iceblade Sorcerer, is a member of the incoming class...right?

A Hyōken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu II : Sekai Saikyō no Majutsushi de Aru Shōnen wa, Majutsu Gakuin ga Nyūgaku Suru sequel manga launched on May 27. Nao Kagami illustrates the manga and Ishiya Ōgane is in charge of composition. Niconico Manga publishes the manga under Kodansha 's " Suiyōbi no Sirius " label.

title: Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love TV Anime Reveals New Visual, 4 More Cast Members
content:
Kadokawa revealed more cast and a new visual on Thursday for the television anime of Ayune Araragi 's Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love ( Isshiki-san wa Koi o Shiritai. ) manga.

The new cast includes:

Kazuya Komai (episode director for Tenjho Tenge , BECK: Mongolian Chop Squad , Pita-Ten ) is directing the anime at Sakura Create . Deko Akao ( Komi Can't Communicate , Noragami , The Case Study of Vanitas ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Shōhei Hamaguchi ( Glamorous Heroes ) is designing the characters.

• Prop Design: Noriyasu Murata

• CG Director: Satomi Nakajima

• CG Production: Studio Twinkle

• Color Key Artist: Akiko Saito

• Art Director: Yasutada Kato

• Compositing Director of Photography: Daisuke Horino

• Editing: Yūsuke Ueno

• Sound Director: Masanori Tsuchiya

• Music: MICHIRU

• Music Production: Kadokawa

The romantic comedy follows Isshiki Rinna Milford, an elite, straight-laced officer who joined the police at age 17 (but has not experienced romantic love), and Meishi Rokutanda, a kind but scatterbrained and incompetent detective. As two newbies at love, they become a couple (of sorts) as they find out about romance.

Araragi launched the manga in Kadokawa 's Monthly Shōnen Ace magazine in June 2020, and Kadokawa published the manga's 10th compiled volume on May 25.

Yen Press has licensed the manga for release in English, and will release the first volume on October 13. While Yen Press initially licensed the manga under the title Ms. Isshiki Wants to Know About Love , the company will now release the manga under the title Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love .

title: Shin Oishinbo TV Anime Reveals Main Cast & Staff Members, 2027 Debut
content:
The official website for Shin Oishinbo (New Oishinbo), the new television anime series of storywriter Tetsu Kariya and artist Akira Hanasaki 's Oishinbo manga, opened on Thursday and revealed the anime's teaser visual, main cast and staff members, and its 2027 debut.

The anime will star:

Yōhei Azakami as Shirō Yamaoka

Hitomi Sasaki as Yūko Kurita

Akio Ōtsuka as Yūzan Kaibara

Ken'ichi Nishida ( Good Bye, Dragon Life , Papuwa , Poka Poka Mori no Rascal ) is directing the anime at Synergy SP and Vega Entertainment . Takahiro Nagano ( Reincarnated as a Sword two seasons, Plannosaurus Gachi Koseibutsu Bu ) is in charge of series scripts, and Nozomi Kawashige ( Good Bye, Dragon Life ) is designing the characters. Shinei Animation is in charge of production.

The duo originally launched the manga in 1983. Shogakukan published the 111th volume in December 2014. The manga has been on hiatus since 2014.

The manga depicts the "fierce food showdown" between the newspaper Tōzai Shimbun's "Ultimate Menu" and gourmand Yuzan Kaibara's "Supreme Menu."

A previous television anime adaptation from Shinei Animation aired for 136 episodes from 1988 to 1992. The anime also includes two additional specials.

Viz Media has published five volumes of Oishinbo on its VizManga.com digital manga service and Viz Manga App, and has also published the volumes in print.

The manga has also inspired several live-action series and a live-action film.
author: ANN

title: 'Bless' Unveils Additional Cast, Character Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Yukino Sonoyama 's Bless manga unveiled additional cast and the character promotional video on Thursday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on Fuji TV's NoitaminA programming block at 11.30. p.m. in January 2027.

Cast Ginga Yoyogi: Nobuhiko Okamoto ( Boku no Hero Academia ) Oroka Sumeragi: Yoshino Aoyama ( Bocchi the Rock! ) Shitataka Sumeragi: Momoka Terasawa ( Make Heroine ga Oosugiru! )

Shoutarou Kitamura ( Make Heroine ga Oosugiru! ) is directing the anime at A-1 Pictures , with Takayuki Kikuchi ( Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai: Ultra Romantic episode director) serving as assistant director. Kamiza Fukurou ( Non Non Biyori Nonstop ) is handling the series composition and script. Honoka Yokoyama ( [Oshi no Ko] 2nd Season ) is designing the characters. Ryo Yoshimata ( Koi wa Ameagari no You ni ) is composing the music.

Sonoyami began serializing the fashion drama manga in Shounen Magazine Edge in January 2022. It was transferred to Shounen Sirius in December 2023. Kodansha published the eighth volume on March 9, with the ninth volume scheduled for an October 8 release.

Kondasha USA licensed the manga for English release in July 2023. The series is simulpublished digitally through Kodansha's K Manga website and app. The seventh volume was released on February 10, with the eighth volume scheduled for an April 2027 release.

Bless ranked 11th in the print category for the 2023 Next Manga Awards .
